# Simplileap

> > Bangalore-based digital transformation company specializing in web development, blockchain, API integration, and UI/UX design services.

Simplileap Digital offers end-to-end technology solutions including ReactJS/WordPress development, custodial wallet development, REST API integration, and maintenance services. The company focuses on modern web technologies, performance optimization, and emerging technologies like blockchain and AI for businesses seeking digital transformation.

## Key Topics

- Digital Transformation
- Web Development (ReactJS, WordPress, Laravel, CodeIgniter)
- API Development & Integration (REST API, WooCommerce, Payment Gateways)
- Blockchain & Custodial Wallet Development
- UI/UX Design & User Research
- Performance Optimization (PageSpeed, Core Web Vitals, INP)
- Website Maintenance & Security
- Shopify & WooCommerce Development
- JavaScript, HTML, CSS, PHP
- Bangalore Technology Services
- HubSpot & ChatGPT Integration
- Fireblocks API Co-Signer
- PostgreSQL & PgBouncer Optimization
- SEO & Digital Marketing
- Logo Design & Branding
